[SWS_PER_00498]
⌈
When ara::per::KeyValueStorage::GetValue is called
for an existing key-value pair with the correct templated data type, Persistency
shall return the stored value of the key-value pair, or, if the value was recently
changed by ara::per::KeyValueStorage::SetValue (also in another thread),
this new temporary value.
⌋
